title: Dashboard
description: How the team is doing against the period before.

period.label: Period
period.invalid: Pick a start that is not after the end.

definitions.title: How these are measured
definitions.first_response_minutes: The middle wait, in minutes, from a lead arriving or a customer writing to the next text or email sent. Waits nobody has answered yet are left out.
definitions.leads_followed: Leads received in the period that got a text or email within 24 hours.
definitions.lead_to_contact: Leads where the customer wrote back after we sent a message.
definitions.contact_to_appointment: Contacted leads that got an appointment booked afterwards.
definitions.appointment_to_show: Those leads whose customer came in.
definitions.show_to_sale: Those leads whose deal reached sold or delivered.
definitions.units_per_salesperson: Deals delivered in the period divided by the salespeople.
